source.description: Where the set came from e.g. CAT 2023 Slot 1, Cracku Sectional 4, AIMCAT2712

set_type.description: Set archetype — the axis the heatmap is built on

perceived_difficulty.description: Intuition rating BEFORE solving. Vault method: 'What makes S easy?' — this column answers it.

actual_difficulty.description: Rating AFTER solving. Gap vs perceived = calibration error, the root cause of bad set selection.

triage_was_correct.description: In hindsight, was the triage call right? Scores set selection separately from solving.

time_seconds.description: Time spent on the set in seconds

solved_fully.description: Was the set cracked completely (grid fully determined)

failure_mode.description: Primary reason it went wrong — different modes need different fixes

notes.description: What the approach should have been; the pattern to remember
